source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: يوم من الأيام، رجعت عالبيت ولقيت حالي بدون مفتاح.
sentences.en: One day, I came home and found myself without a key.

sentences.ar: فتشت بجيبي وبالشنطة بس ما لقيته.
sentences.en: I searched my pocket and my bag but didn't find it.

sentences.ar: تذكرت إني كنت بالسوق قبل شوي.
sentences.en: I remembered I had been at the market a little earlier.

sentences.ar: رجعت عالسوق ورحت عند كل دكان زرتها.
sentences.en: I went back to the market and visited every shop I'd been to.

sentences.ar: سألت البياعين إذا حدا لقى مفتاح.
sentences.en: I asked the sellers if anyone had found a key.

sentences.ar: واحد منهم ضحك وطلعلي المفتاح من الدرج.
sentences.en: One of them laughed and took the key out of the drawer.

sentences.ar: قال إني نسيته لما دفعت حق الخضرة.
sentences.en: He said I forgot it when I paid for the vegetables.
I thanked him a lot and went home relieved.

sentences.ar: من يومها، بربط المفتاح بخيط بجيبي.
sentences.en: Since that day, I tie the key with a string in my pocket.
